item.description: The deal was expected to halt fighting for 60 days, open the Strait of Hormuz and lift the U.S. naval blockade on Iranian ports. But it would leave the thorniest nuclear issues for another day.

item.title: Deadlocked Wars: How Major Powers Misread the Regions They Attacked

item.title: Germany and Japan Are Rearming Again, 80 Years After World War II
